1. **Check SEC EDGAR directly**: You can search for *"Exxon Mobil Corporation"* (the legacy operating entity) at [sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar) to find its historical 10-K filings and revenue figures.
2. **ExxonMobil's Investor Relations page**: ExxonMobil publishes annual reports and earnings releases at [ir.exxonmobil.com](https://ir.exxonmobil.com), which will have the most up-to-date revenue figures.
